citations.excerpt: Keble's sermon in itself not very striking on "National Apostasy", had marked 14 July, 1833, as the birthday of a "second Reformation ."

facts.value: Movement within the Church of England associated with the Tracts for the Times, published from 1833 to 1841.

citations.excerpt: That is the point of view maintained in the "Tracts for the Times" from 1833 to 1841, which gave its familiar name to the "Tractarian" Movement.
